phase_protocol.performance: Fixed-length load may use ignore_eos=true; run three measured repetitions only after health 200 and warmup.
phase_protocol.quality: Use seed=0, temperature=0, enable_thinking=false, ignore_eos=false, trust_remote_code=false and extract_non_reasoning_content; run three repetitions.
phase_protocol.isolation: For each G1-G4 group, complete performance, stop the service, restart the exact same frozen group configuration, wait for health 200, then run quality. Never reuse profiler/capture state for quality.
phase_protocol.provenance: Adapted from the supplied successful batch_size=32 HYPIC piercing record; host/device IDs and absolute paths are deliberately not copied.

native_treatment.activation: apply restart-safely, then prove torch_npu.npu_chunk_gated_delta_rule executed; source presence alone is insufficient

one_variable_rule: Within each paired comparison exactly one declared switch may change; all immutable fields and artifact hashes must match.

second_model.layout: 32 layers: 24 linear_attention plus 8 full_attention; hidden_size 2560; 32 linear value heads
second_model.status: available locally; must receive its own true DRRQR conversion and load/correctness validation

quality_gate.condition_A: Shared discrete accuracy values across groups are supporting evidence, not sufficient proof.
quality_gate.condition_B: Aggregate mean difference may be called noise-level only after baseline NPU nondeterminism is measured on the same frozen suite; 1-2 percentage points is a prior, not a universal threshold.
quality_gate.condition_C: For deterministic short-output canaries (<=512 output tokens), require zero within-group variance and exact baseline/treatment token equality where deterministic execution is expected.
additional_structural_pruning_gates: No material per-dataset regression hidden by aggregate mean.
DRRQR must be evaluated separately from fixed-channel and L1 heuristics.
quality_gate.lossless_wording: Use 'accuracy lossless within measured NPU noise on this frozen suite' only if all applicable gates pass; never claim mathematical equivalence from aggregate score alone.

promotion_gate: all required datasets materialized and hashed
clean performance gain and profiler mechanism agree
